components.title: Icon List & Collection (Drupal Custom Paragraph Bundles)
components.twigTemplate: paragraph--uswds-icon-list.html.twig, paragraph--uswds-icon-list-item.html.twig, paragraph--uswds-collection.html.twig, paragraph--uswds-collection-item.html.twig in modules/custom/{project}_additional_uswds_paragraph_components/modules/{project}_uswds_icon_list/templates/ and .../{project}_uswds_collection/templates/
components.preprocessFunction: {project}_uswds_icon_list_preprocess_paragraph__uswds_icon_list() and {project}_uswds_collection_preprocess_paragraph__uswds_collection() — populate icon sprite references, item arrays, and variant classes
components.configYaml:
# modules/custom/{project}_additional_uswds_paragraph_components/{project}_additional_uswds_paragraph_components.info.yml
name: 'Additional USWDS Paragraph Components'
type: module
dependencies:
  - paragraphs
  - entity_reference_revisions
  - uswds_paragraph_components

# Submodule: {project}_uswds_icon_list/{project}_uswds_icon_list.info.yml
dependencies:
  - {project}_additional_uswds_paragraph_components
  - paragraphs

# Paragraph bundle: uswds_icon_list (parent) with field_uswds_icon_list_items (ER-revisions, target=uswds_icon_list_item, unlimited)
# Paragraph bundle: uswds_icon_list_item with fields: field_uswds_icon (svg via media library or sprite name text), field_uswds_heading, field_uswds_body, field_uswds_link

# Submodule: {project}_uswds_collection/{project}_uswds_collection.info.yml
# Paragraph bundle: uswds_collection (parent) with field_uswds_collection_items (ER-revisions, target=uswds_collection_item)
# Paragraph bundle: uswds_collection_item with fields: field_uswds_heading, field_uswds_body, field_uswds_link, field_uswds_meta (optional author/date)
components.scssSettings: $theme-icon-list-font-family, $theme-collection-font-family — typically just consume USWDS utility classes; minimal custom SCSS

fieldDefinitions.uswds_icon_list_item.field_uswds_icon: Text field for USWDS sprite name (e.g., 'check_circle', 'arrow_forward') or media reference to SVG
fieldDefinitions.uswds_icon_list_item.field_uswds_body: Text formatted field for item body
fieldDefinitions.uswds_collection_item.field_uswds_body: Text formatted field for item body
fieldDefinitions.uswds_collection_item.field_uswds_meta: Text field for meta info (author, date)

components.title: USWDS Layout Builder Bridge (Drupal Custom Module)
components.twigTemplate: block--block-content--uswds-paragraph-blocks.html.twig in themes/custom/mytheme/templates/. Layout plugin template: layouts--uswds-grid--twocol.html.twig. Both rely on the paragraphs ER-revisions field rendering the child bundles (uswds_card_group_regular, uswds_accordion, uswds_alert, etc.).
components.preprocessFunction: mytheme_uswds_layouts_preprocess_block__block_content__uswds_paragraph_blocks() — set $variables['uswds_bundles'] from field_uswds_bundles. Optional: mytheme_preprocess_layout() to inject USWDS grid classes based on the layout configuration.
drushCommands: composer require drupal/layout_builder drupal/paragraphs drupal/entity_reference_revisions drupal/block_content
drush pm:enable layout_builder paragraphs entity_reference_revisions block_content
components.configYaml:
# modules/custom/mytheme_uswds_layouts/mytheme_uswds_layouts.info.yml
name: 'USWDS Layout Builder Bridge'
type: module
dependencies:
  - layout_builder
  - block_content
  - paragraphs
  - entity_reference_revisions
  - uswds_paragraph_components

# block_content type: uswds_paragraph_blocks
# field: field_uswds_bundles (entity_reference_revisions, target_type=paragraph, unlimited)
# allowed bundles: all uswds_* paragraph types enabled on the site

# Enable Layout Builder on the target content type (e.g., landing_page):
# /admin/structure/types/manage/landing_page/display/default
# → Use Layout Builder: ✓
# → Allow custom layouts: ✓
components.scssSettings: $theme-grid-gap, $theme-grid-gutter, $theme-container-max-width — keep layouts aligned with USWDS grid utilities

fieldDefinitions.field_uswds_bundles: Entity reference revisions to paragraph (unlimited). Allowed bundles: uswds_accordion, uswds_alert, uswds_card_group_regular, uswds_card_group_flag, uswds_modal, uswds_process_list, uswds_step_indicator, uswds_summary_box, plus any custom uswds_* bundles the site defines

components.title: Mega Menu Header (Drupal Custom Twig)
components.twigTemplate: tbm-nav.html.twig, tbm-link.html.twig, tbm-subnav.html.twig, and tb-megamenu-column-inner.html.twig in themes/custom/mytheme/templates/. Wrap the entire <nav class="tbm"> in <div class="usa-nav__inner"> and each <ul class="tbm-nav"> becomes a usa-nav__primary usa-accordion list. Override menu.html.twig (the 'Featured Topics' menu block inside the mega menu) to render as a usa-list with usa-link anchors and usa-sr-only headings.
components.preprocessFunction: mytheme_preprocess_tbm_nav() — add usa-accordion and usa-nav__primary classes to $variables['classes_array']. mytheme_preprocess_tbm_link() — add usa-nav__link class to anchor. mytheme_preprocess_menu__featured_topics() — render 'Featured Topics' menu as a usa-list with navigation__link-description spans under each link (mirrors gsa.gov usa-featured--topics block).
components.configYaml:
# /admin/structure/tb-megamenu
# Configure a mega menu based on the 'main' menu.
# Set data-breakpoint to match $theme-header-min-width (typically 1200 for extended header).

# Featured Topics column:
# Create a separate Drupal menu (machine name: featured_topics) with menu items that include a description.
# Place it inside the mega menu's last column via the TB Mega Menu admin UI as a 'menu block'.
# Override its template to render as usa-list with navigation__link-description.
